hypothesis: Describe how agents will collaborate and why that could improve investment research.
resourceMatching: Compare a capable single agent, a single agent with extra review/compute, and your multi-agent approach. Explain how model capability, tools, sources and actual resource use affect the comparison.
caseSelectionRationale: Explain the questions, companies and sampling choices.
developmentFinalSplit: Explain how you avoid tuning to final answers; a held-back set is one option, not a required method.
measurementValidation: Explain reference evidence, judge checks and manual audits.
repetitionsAndUncertainty: Choose repetitions or another justified noise-control method.
failurePolicy: Explain how failed and incomplete runs enter the results.
usageAccounting: Record spend, tokens, tool calls and elapsed time.
informationCutoffsAndLeakage: Explain source eligibility, what models may already know from training, how this could affect results, and how your design addresses it and its remaining limitations.
analysisPlan: Define how results support or contradict the hypothesis.
frozenPlanCommit: Record the commit used before final evaluation.
